story.text: Back at Longbourn, Elizabeth can keep it in no longer. She tells {JANE} of Darcy’s {PROPOSAL} and of his {LETTER}. Jane, who thinks well of everyone, is {SADDENED} to learn what {WICKHAM} really is. Should they warn the town? The regiment leaves in a {FORTNIGHT}, and Darcy never asked them to speak. So the sisters agree to keep the {SECRET}, a silence Elizabeth will one day bitterly regret.
story.caption: Elizabeth and Jane, alone at last
